name: linalg_multi_dot_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_multi_dot.out(Tensor[] tensors, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Computes a matrix-chain product into out. Tests cover empty-output resize, output identity, vector endpoint shapes, noncontiguous output storage, and matrix chains of several lengths, accepted floating dtype conversion, and rejected integer output buffers.
